title: Ornith 1.5 122B at 4-bit reported going from 91 to 242 tok/s on an M5 Ultra with a DFlash2 drafter, output identical
summary: A single-user test of speculative decoding with a DFlash2 drafter on Mac, reported token-for-token identical output, with the gain dropping to about 20% at four concurrent chats. No repo link or method shown; Mac support credited to two other builders.

appearances.title: DFlash2 raises Ornith 1.5 from 91 to 242 tok/s on an M5 Ultra
appearances.summary: On an M5 Ultra, speculative decoding with a DFlash2 drafter raised 4-bit Ornith 1.5 122B from 91 to 242 tokens per second with identical output tokens. With four chats at once the gain fell to about 20 percent. Mac support is from @BobClawblaw and @ashxhart.
